name: How much does it cost to install garage floor tiles?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install garage floor tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of garage floor tile installation varies widely based on the tile material, garage size, subfloor preparation needed, and labor rates in the Bay Area. Plastic interlocking tiles can range from $2-$8 per square foot for materials, plus installation. Rubber tiles may be $3-$10 per square foot. More durable options like porcelain can be $5-$15+ per square foot. Professional installation typically adds $2-$5 per square foot. It's best to get a detailed quote for your specific project to understand the total investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage tile installation costs depend on material, garage size, subfloor preparation, and local labor rates, typically ranging from $2-$15+ per square foot for materials plus installation.
